name: cevimeline
uses: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE EVOXAC is indicated for the treatment of symptoms of dry mouth in adults with Sjögren’s disease. EVOXAC is a cholinergic agonist indicated for the treatment of symptoms of dry mouth in adults with Sjögren’s disease. ( 1 )

interactions: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Beta-adrenergic Antagonists Prevention or Management Closely monitor patients who concomitantly use EVOXAC with beta-adrenergic antagonists. Mechanism and Clinical Effect(s) Concomitant use of EVOXAC with beta-adrenergic antagonists may result in cardiac conduction disturbances. Muscarinic Antagonists Prevention or Management Closely monitor patients who concomitantly use EVOXAC with muscarinic antagonists. Mechanism and Clinical Effect(s) Concomitant use of EVOXAC with muscarinic antagonists may interfere with antimuscarinic drugs effects. Cholinergic Agonists Prevention or Management Closely monitor patients who concomitantly use EVOXAC with other cholinergic agonists. Mechanism and Clinical Effect(s) Concomitant use of EVOXAC with other cholinergic agonists can potentiate the cholinergic effects of EVOXAC and increase the risk of adverse reactions [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.4 )]. CYP2D6 and CYP3A3/4 Inhibitors Prevention or Management Closely monitor patients who concomitantly use EVOXAC with CYP2D6 and/or CYP3A3/4 inhibitors for EVOXAC-associated adverse reactions. Mechanism and Clinical Effect(s) CYP2D6 and CYP3A3/4 inhibitors can inhibit the metabolism of cevimeline and may increase the risk of EVOXAC-associated adverse reactions.
